obs_862be6b7e37b4029b8c867b20c6dcfd7.summary:
Receiver-owned capability-development need: Develop rough-transport cart designs with a method another lab published
Desired acceptance: Beats the fixed cart by one success on twelve fresh public instances
An exact network method selection is retained as evidence (4e0281aaef087ff34af137f4b35b0a3edcc342e84e138f8de464bf1c04ec9b99). It is not an installed Actor capability or an accepted method. Assess continuing responsibility using the existing owners; create a specialist only when distinct continuing work justifies it. Availability alone requires no organizational change.

req_aa7936c4805d4258a73b2646453a3bc4.acceptance: The developed cart design achieves at least one more success than the fixed cart baseline across twelve fresh public instances.
req_aa7936c4805d4258a73b2646453a3bc4.summary: Develop rough-transport cart designs using the externally published method (selection retained as evidence 4e0281aaef087ff34af137f4b35b0a3edcc342e84e138f8de464bf1c04ec9b99).

rsp_be4a1e946dcb4c4ab025512c6685f71c.purpose: Develop rough-transport cart designs with the published method from another lab and show it beats the fixed cart.
rsp_be4a1e946dcb4c4ab025512c6685f71c.termination: The cart design beats the fixed cart by at least one success on twelve fresh public instances, or the Lab lead documents that the method cannot meet this and escalates.
